newsitem.title: USA: Celulosa Arauco to buy Alto Parana for $228 mln.
newsitem.headline: Celulosa Arauco to buy Alto Parana for $228 mln.

text.p: Chile's Celulosa y Constitucion S.A. said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy 94.64 percent of the shares of Argentina's Alto Parana S.A. (APSA) for $228.2 million.
In a statement, Celulosa said it also would buy 99.73 percent of APSA's outstanding convertible debt for $58.8 million.
Another $18 million will be deposited in escrow by the sellers to guarantee the collection of certain receivables of APSA.
Celulosa is controlled by Chile's Angelini group. Alto Parana was put up for sale this year by Citicorp and a group of Latin American banks which control most of its shares.
APSA is a bleached softwood kraft and forest products producer in Argentina's northern state of Misiones. Its plant produces about 250,000 tons of pulp a year.
APSA's total assets as of June 30 totaled $675 million.
